title: Connect actual Core interiors to the global physical caller (no new κ)
body:
## Summary

Connect actual dyadic Core interior cells to the global physical Full caller. The construction consumes the unchanged carve/partition source, authentic RawGaussian parameters and stored forward/inverse programs, then gathers arbitrary selected axes and returns them to their original positions.

The proof supplies a common precision grid, complete tensor error bounds and a bill including both physical gathers, every H/diagonal event, source caches and setup. Its stated polynomial grouping regime is favorable under the inherited native tariff. **No new κ.**

## Evidence

Base: `7c49fe32c55de02c2c873655c804b16e4c3fef0a`. SOURCES.json pins 74 canonical inputs and twelve unchanged files from the [physical Full caller](https://github.com/CubeJerry/integer-mult-bounds/tree/d51859e7816771f627033b23db0f9786ada863f8/research/full-global-tensor-caller).

```sh
python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/core-interior-global-cohort
```

Expected: `PASS_ACTUAL_CORE_SOURCE`, `PASS_ACTUAL_CORE_MULTIAXIS` and `PASS_ACTUAL_CORE_PHYSICAL_PREFIX`. All six normal/optimized checks passed for author and lead; independent source, layout, parameter and cost review passed. Committed bytes/modes match the tested package.

The complete host checks execute 1,105 single-axis and 1,955 two-axis events; the latter covers eight labels, 8,192 records and 28,702 nonzero roundings. An independent serializer checks 60,536,842 control bits. The physical witness executes the gather, first H event and inverse gather with 22 borrowed tapes and disclosed reduced q=2 parameters. It does not execute all 1,105 events physically. Twenty-six source/geometry controls and three physical controls pass.

## Scope and open next questions

The producer uses Core's actual partition source and a validated constructor shell; it does not execute Core.__init__ Schur/LU or full Core.execute. Boundary rows are exact identities before global rounding, without a bitwise-restoration claim. Source preparation is fully charged, including its exponential-in-local-width cache factor. This package retains Karatsuba scalars and is independent of20the separate FFT adapter.

Boundary/halo assembly, CRT/recovery, complete native admission and the outer theorem remain obligations. Open #6880 is complementary and supplies no imported premise. Next: compose the interior service with the actual boundary consumer and prove the complete outer invoice.

## Credit

Prepared for @CubeJerry with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance and independent AI source/mathematical review; no human or proof-kernel acceptance is claimed. Credit Vlado Vojdanovski, Jose Manuel/jmbarrancoml and #4253, #4178, #4786, #5018, #5104, #3709 and #3627. Full proof, exact pins, receipts and limitations: [research package](https://github.com/CubeJerry/integer-mult-bounds/tree/61d86cbe25657af55b9463bd3f072b6cbf952638/research/core-interior-global-cohort).
